text:
I’m passionate about building practical data solutions and I’m a hard-working freelancer with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization.

Your Power BI custom visuals project is a strong fit for my background. I understand the challenge you’re facing with Charticulator-based visuals breaking when slicers, filters, and axis scrolling are involved. A roadmap visual with Month-Year on the X axis, Product Name on the Y axis, and milestones plotted in the chart area needs to behave reliably alongside the rest of the report, not just look right in isolation. I’d approach this with a focus on making sure the visual integrates cleanly with Power BI interactions and stays usable as users filter and explore the data.

One relevant project I completed was Support ticket analytics for Clipboardly, a productivity software client. I built a support dashboard with a cleaned-up tag taxonomy, response times, and backlog by product area using SQL and Power BI. One result from that work was that first response time went down 27% after staffing changes the dashboard suggested. That project required careful data structuring, dashboard design, and making sure the analysis was clear and actionable.

For your roadmap visual, I can help review the current requirement, identify why the existing Charticulator approach is running into issues, and discuss a better structure for a custom visual that supports slicers, filters, and axis scrolling more reliably. I’m comfortable working through the data model, the visual behavior, and the presentation layer so the final result fits your org’s requirements.

If you’d like, I’d be happy to talk through the details of the milestone data, interactions, and expected behavior so we can define the best path forward.
